selfCheck.intro: Four quick questions. Answer honestly — there's no wrong answer, just a clearer picture of where your roof actually stands.

questions.q: Missing, cracked, or curling shingles anywhere on the roof?
Granules piling up in the gutters or at the downspouts?
Any daylight, water stains, or soft spots in the attic?
Hail, high wind, or a falling branch in the last year or two?

services.title: Roof Repair
services.desc: Missing shingles, active leaks, flashing failures — patched fast, matched close, done right the first time.

services.title: Full Roof Replacement

services.title: Storm Damage & Insurance Claims

services.title: Gutter Repair & Replacement

owner.name: Marcus Teague
owner.bio: Marcus Teague spent his early career on repair crews before he ever pulled a permit of his own — flashing failures at 2am, storm damage nobody wanted to climb up and look at, the jobs other crews put off. Eventually he started the company with one truck and a rule: walk every roof in person before quoting it, and never sell a replacement a repair could fix. He still climbs most roofs himself.

faq.q: How does the insurance claim process work?
faq.a: We do a free inspection first and tell you honestly whether the damage looks claim-worthy. If it does, we document everything with photos and can meet your adjuster on-site to walk the roof together — the estimate itself is between you and your insurer, we just make sure nothing gets missed.

faq.q: How long does a full replacement take?
faq.a: Most single-family roofs are a one- to two-day tear-off and reroof, weather permitting. We'll give you a real date range before work starts, not just “a few days.”

faq.q: What roofing materials do you install?
faq.a: Architectural asphalt shingles cover most of what we do, with metal and synthetic options available for specific jobs — we'll talk through what fits your roof and budget during the inspection.
For active leaks, yes — call and we'll get a tarp or temporary patch on same-day where possible, then schedule the real repair.

faq.q: How much does a repair cost?
faq.a: See the Pricing section above for typical ranges — every roof is different, so the exact number comes after a free inspection, not a guess over the phone.
